tab_list.tab_title: English is an official national language
tab_list.tab_description: English, as Malta’s official language, makes studying, working, and living easier while enhancing your language skills.

tab_list.tab_title: Malta is a Schengen Zone country
tab_list.tab_description: Malta, a Schengen Zone country, offers easy travel access across Europe for students and visitors.
Our guidance helps you navigate Malta’s streamlined and efficient student visa process, ensuring a quick and successful application.
Launch your career in Malta after you graduate. This visa extension gives you nine months to stay in Malta to seek employment and gain international experience.

settings.section_title: Plan Every Step of Studying in Malta

tabs.tab_title: Do I need a visa to study in Malta?
tabs.tab_content: Students from the EU do not need a visa. Most students from outside the EU need a student visa and a residence permit for courses longer than 90 days. Requirements depend on your nationality and your course, and we help you prepare your application.

tabs.tab_title: Can I work while studying in Malta?
tabs.tab_content: Yes. Non-EU students with a valid student residence permit can usually work up to 20 hours per week. Read our guide to working while studying in Malta for the rules and job types.

tabs.tab_title: How much does it cost to study in Malta?
tabs.tab_content: It depends on the programme and school. For example, our 12-month Professional English Programme has a launch price of €3,950. See our guide to the cost of studying in Malta for living costs.

tabs.tab_title: What level of English do I need?
tabs.tab_content: English courses accept all levels. Diplomas and degrees usually ask for proof of English, such as an IELTS score or an equivalent test. We tell you the exact level your chosen programme needs.

tabs.tab_title: Can I stay in Malta after I graduate?
tabs.tab_content: Eligible graduates can apply for a 9-month post-study visa extension to look for work in Malta and gain international experience.

tabs.tab_title: How does Outreach Study help me?
tabs.tab_content: We give you a free consultation, help you choose a programme and school, support your application, visa and residence permit, and give practical advice for your arrival in Malta.
